title: Collar Bells RING Before Every Mistake 🔔
description:
In this town, everyone wears a small brass bell on their collar, and it rings just before you make a mistake. The second yours goes off, you freeze.

My big brother runs the car wash on the edge of town by himself now, and lately his bell won't stop ringing. So I went back to help him. Then the tunnel started running with nobody in it, and wet footprints lined up inside, five pairs, each one fainter than the last.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment BELL if yours would have rung this week.
old_title: A Bell RINGS Before Every Mistake 🔔
